protocol.primary_scope: controller frozen runner call including Git preparation and guest collector start/stop
protocol.end_to_end_scope: outer controller start through tests, cleanup and private image hash inventory/removal
protocol.host_scope: run-owned sandbox parent cgroup; excludes orchestrator
protocol.guest_scope: one persistent collector per runner; includes preparation; short steps may have no samples
protocol.cpu_cache_policy: original frequency/affinity and guest defaults; fresh private VM; host cache preserved; no cache drops
protocol.official_tests: four task assertions in every run; independent properties and final patch also verified
protocol.stop_policy: first failure, source/environment change, oversized raw results or disk guard; no automatic retries
protocol.inference: five independent group log ratios with approximate t95 intervals; no PPT performance threshold
protocol.interrupted_batch_semantics: functional smoke only; interrupted original kept; not formal statistical observations

limitations: Original CPU frequency/affinity and guest defaults; no fair cross-backend comparison
End-to-end includes official task tests and private-image hash inventory/removal
No physical page scanning; guest logical memory and host cgroup are not added
Five group log-ratio t95 intervals are approximate; no PPT performance threshold
Mirrored order balances linear ordinal drift, not arbitrary shared-host load changes
meaning: correctness, data and offline recount pass; no numerical threshold verdict

official_manifest.scope: official task-specific test command and F2P/P2P; not entire Prettier suite

storage.scope: outer guarded command including private image inventory/removal; sampled every 0.25 seconds

all_off_sensitivity.scope: post-hoc descriptive sensitivity using all six monitoring-off observations per group; primary analysis unchanged

exploratory_step_variation.scope: post-hoc descriptive localization; not causal evidence; primary analysis unchanged

host_composition_at_observed_peak.scope: same host sampler row; sequential counter reads, no normalization; run-owned sandbox parent cgroup

guest_collector.scope: collector process resource usage; maxrss is not private memory
